tasks.title: Audit AF-AUTO-002 Scope and Generate Execution Baseline
tasks.description: Audit the current codebase for always-on data ingestion and template-driven report generation readiness, then produce a precise execution baseline for AF-AUTO-002 without modifying business logic.
success_criteria: Current ingestion capabilities for CLS, CNStock, and ZQ are documented
Current report/template capabilities are documented
Known schema gaps, scheduling gaps, and UI gaps are listed
A bootstrap report is created for AF-AUTO-002
verification_commands: python -m pytest tests/ -k 'ingest or report' -v --tb=short
python -m uvicorn app.api.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --workers 1 & sleep 5 && curl -f http://127.0.0.1:8000/health && pkill -f uvicorn

tasks.title: Audit Live Ingestion Readiness for CLS CNStock and ZQ
tasks.description: Audit the existing ingestion pipeline for 财联社, 中国证券报/中国证券网, and 知丘, including fetch entrypoints, dedupe behavior, stop conditions, and database persistence fields.
success_criteria: CLS ingestion path is documented end-to-end
CNStock ingestion path is documented end-to-end
ZQ ingestion path is documented end-to-end
Current dedupe and persistence assumptions are documented
A readiness audit report is created
verification_commands: grep -R "fetch_news_cls\|fetch_news_cnstock\|fetch_reports_zq" -n data_layer app core
grep -R "ingest_envelope" -n app core

tasks.title: Implement Trading Session Aware Scheduler
tasks.description: Implement a scheduler that runs data fetching only during A-share trading sessions, supports midday break and market close behavior, and is configurable for future trading-calendar extension.
success_criteria: Scheduler only runs inside configured trading sessions
Midday break handling is implemented
Scheduler can be manually started and stopped
Scheduler behavior is documented in a report
verification_commands: python -m pytest tests/ -k 'scheduler or crawl_scheduler or trading_session' -v --tb=short

tasks.title: Implement Incremental Fetch Until Known Logic
tasks.description: Implement fetch loops for CLS, CNStock, and ZQ that continue pulling the newest data until previously ingested records are encountered, then stop cleanly.
success_criteria: Incremental stop condition is implemented for all target sources
Previously ingested records terminate the current fetch loop
Repeated runs do not duplicate persisted records
A report describing the stop logic and dedupe behavior is created
verification_commands: python -m pytest tests/ -k 'dedupe or ingestion_queue or incremental or ingest' -v --tb=short

tasks.title: Harden Anti Crawl and Retry Strategy
tasks.description: Add practical anti-crawl safeguards including rate limiting, jitter, exponential backoff, retry policy, and per-source fetch pacing for the live ingestion workflow.
success_criteria: Per-source rate limiting is configurable
Retry and backoff strategy is implemented
Jitter or pacing randomness is added
A report documents anti-crawl behavior and limits
verification_commands: python -m pytest tests/ -k 'retry or backoff or anti_crawl or crawler' -v --tb=short

tasks.title: Implement ZQ PDF First Report Ingestion
tasks.description: Make 知丘 REPORT ingestion prefer PDF artifacts first, record PDF metadata, and fall back only when PDF is unavailable or explicitly disabled.
success_criteria: ZQ report ingestion prefers PDF-first workflow
PDF file path and hash metadata are captured
Fallback logic is explicit and documented
A PDF-first ingestion report is created
verification_commands: python -m pytest tests/ -k 'zq or pdf or ingest_file or report_fetcher' -v --tb=short

tasks.title: Add PDF to Markdown Conversion Pipeline
tasks.description: Add a pluggable PDF ingestion strategy layer that supports raw text extraction fallback and markdown conversion strategies such as MarkItDown and MinerU where available.
success_criteria: PDF ingestion strategy abstraction is implemented
Markdown conversion output is stored separately from raw text
Fallback path works when external converters are unavailable
A conversion strategy report is created
verification_commands: python -m pytest tests/ -k 'pdf or markdown or ingest_file or report' -v --tb=short

tasks.title: Audit and Extend Ingestion Database Schema
tasks.description: Audit document, assertion, event, and related persistence schemas, then extend them to support crawler state, source identifiers, parsing metadata, markdown output, and fetch lineage.
success_criteria: Schema audit is completed
Missing ingestion metadata fields are identified and implemented where needed
Storage of dedupe keys, fetch timestamps, parse strategy, and raw asset metadata is documented
A schema extension report is created
verification_commands: python -m pytest tests/ -k 'repository or migration or schema or ingest' -v --tb=short
